annotation.interpretation_a: CONNECTION_CLOSE frames of type 0x1d are permitted in 1-RTT packets, and disallowed in all other encryption levels.
annotation.interpretation_b: CONNECTION_CLOSE frames of type 0x1d are *required* to be sent in 1-RTT packets, but may also be sent in other encryption levels.
annotation.justification: The use of "MUST only be sent" can be interpreted as either "must be sent in, and only in" or "must be sent at, but may also be sent in". This creates ambiguity about whether the frames are disallowed in other levels, or simply required in 1-RTT.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the restriction is exclusive (only 1-RTT) or inclusive (at least 1-RTT).
